educationalGoal: Artificial intelligence that can bring intelligence to machines is becoming increasingly important in various areas of the ICT society. This course aims to have students master basic technologies related to artificial intelligence, and in particular, to deepen their understanding of deep learning and its application systems, which are important technologies for realizing intelligent systems. Students will further develop their basic knowledge of intelligent information processing and deepen their understanding of how to build intelligent systems.
advice: Course Description and Expectations for Students This course covers the basic to application of intelligent information processing. Students will learn the basic techniques for various deep learning and build and evaluate application systems based on these deep learning techniques. Students are expected to be able to evaluate the methods and challenges of implementing an application system for intelligent information processing.
